name: Advanced Search
longdescription: Provides deterministic category searches for purchase, credential access, networking, file activity, execution, persistence, surveillance, cryptography, and anti-analysis behaviors. Optional AI mode sends only a bounded function summary to a configurable OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
